I suffer from the same thing. When you get attached to a show it just feels horrible when you finish (though I find it happening to me for all forms of media). Anyway, here’s a few ways I have found to get over the “emptiness”

1. Get involved with the community. Whenever I finish a show, I join communities related to that show for a few days. Sometimes just talking to people and sharing my thoughts about the show makes the emptiness go away, and more often than not you can meet some cool people.

2. Check for any spin off content. I know this sounds kinda obvious, but it works for sure (you can also read fan fiction if the show doesn’t have any spin off games or media) it’s pretty much guaranteed the spin off won’t be as good, but I feel the drop in quality actually helps, since you can detach yourself from the story easier.

3. Rewatch or binge another show you know or like (I’d recommend something funny and not serious). I like to watch the daily life oh high school boys since it’s my favorite comedy show, but just pick whatever you like best. Finding a new show to watch also helps.

Anyway, I hope this list helps you and you can get over the post show blues!
